title: 第3章 函谷关外，十年征伐
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
“轰！”

    这个任命，如同一道惊雷，在所有大臣的脑海中炸响。

    上卿！

    这可是秦国最顶尖的官职之一，地位尊崇无比。

    而且，还总领灭六国事宜？

    这等于将秦国未来最重要的国策，交到了一个今天才第一次上殿的陌生人手里！

    “大王，万万不可啊！”

    一名老臣立刻出列，跪地哭喊道，“此人来历不明，言语怪诞，岂可担当如此重任！请大王三思！”

    “是啊大王！灭国大事，岂同儿戏！”

    “请大王收回成命！”

    一时间，殿内反对之声四起。

    他们无法接受，一个不知道从哪里冒出来的“方士”，一跃成为他们的顶头上司。

    李斯虽然没有说话，但紧锁的眉头也表明了他的态度。

    这个决定，太过草率，太过冒险了。

    嬴政冷冷地看着下方的群臣，冰冷的杀气弥漫开来。

    “寡人的话，你们没听清吗？”

    “还是说，你们觉得，寡人的决定，需要经过你们的同意？”

    冰冷的声音让大殿内的温度都下降了几分。

    群臣顿时噤若寒蝉，再也不敢多说一个字。

    他们都清楚，秦王一旦做了决定，就绝无更改的可能。

    违逆他，只有死路一条。

    嬴政不再理会他们，他看向顾长青，眼神中充满了信任与期许。

    “上卿，寡人的天下，寡人的万世基业，就交到你手上了！”

    顾长青心中也是感慨万千。

    他本以为，要费一番口舌，甚至要展露更多手段，才能获得嬴政的初步信任。

    没想到，仅仅一个战略规划，就让他直接登上了秦国权力的巅峰。

    这位千古一帝的魄力与决断，果然非同凡响。

    他知道，嬴政拜他为上卿，一是为了这个灭国之策，二，也是为了那虚无缥缈的长生。

    这是一场豪赌。

    嬴政赌他能带来胜利和长生。
content_en:
"Boom!"

    This appointment was like a thunder that exploded in the minds of all the ministers.

    Sir!

    This is one of the top official positions in the Qin State, and its status is extremely respected.

    Moreover, he also took charge of the matter of destroying the six countries?

    This is tantamount to handing Qin's most important national policy in the future into the hands of a stranger who just went to the palace for the first time today!

    "Your Majesty, you must not do this!"

    An old minister immediately came out of the queue, knelt down and cried, "This person has unknown origins and speaks weird words. How can he take on such an important responsibility! Please think again, my king!"

    "Yes, Your Majesty! Destroying a country is nothing more than child's play!"

    "Please, Your Majesty, take back your life!"

    For a time, voices of opposition arose in the palace.

    They couldn't accept that a "alchemist" appeared out of nowhere and suddenly became their immediate boss.

    Although Li Si did not speak, his frown also showed his attitude.

    This decision was too hasty and too risky.

    Ying Zheng looked coldly at the ministers below, and a cold murderous aura filled the air.

    "Didn't you hear what I said clearly?"

    "Or do you think that my decision needs your consent?"

    The cold voice made the temperature in the hall drop a bit.

    The ministers immediately fell silent and did not dare to say another word.

    They all knew that once King Qin made a decision, there was no possibility of changing it.

    Disobeying him will lead to death.

    Ying Zheng ignored them and looked at Gu Changqing, his eyes full of trust and expectation.

    "Your Majesty, my world and my inheritance for eternity are in your hands!"

    Gu Changqing was also filled with emotions.

    He originally thought that it would take a lot of words and even more tricks to gain Ying Zheng's initial trust.

    Unexpectedly, just one strategic plan brought him directly to the pinnacle of Qin's power.

    The courage and determination of this eternal emperor are indeed extraordinary.

    He knew that Ying Zheng worshiped him as his minister, firstly for this strategy of destroying the country, and secondly, for the elusive eternal life.

    It's a big gamble.

    Ying Zheng bets that he can bring victory and immortality.
title_en: Chapter 3 Outside Hangu Pass, Ten Years of Conquest
